url_length.label: URL length
url_length.description: Characters in the normalised URL, scheme included.

query_length.label: Query length
query_length.description: Characters in the query string, without '?'.

path_segment_count.label: Path segments
path_segment_count.description: Non-empty segments separated by '/' in the path.

path_depth_has_extension.label: File extension in path
path_depth_has_extension.description: 1 if the last path segment looks like a file name (contains a '.').

query_param_count.label: Query parameters
query_param_count.description: Number of key=value pairs in the query string.

subdomain_count.label: Subdomain levels
subdomain_count.description: Hostname labels left of the registrable domain (0 for IP hosts).

longest_label_length.label: Longest hostname label
longest_label_length.description: Length of the longest hostname label.

registrable_domain_length.label: Registrable domain length
registrable_domain_length.description: Length of the registrable domain (public suffix + one label).

tld_length.label: Public suffix length
tld_length.description: Length of the public suffix, e.g. 'co.uk' = 5 (0 for IP hosts).

is_https.label: Uses HTTPS
is_https.description: 1 if the scheme is https. A weak signal; HTTPS does not prove legitimacy.

is_ip_host.label: IP address as host
is_ip_host.description: 1 if the hostname is an IPv4 or IPv6 literal.

has_nonstandard_port.label: Non-standard port
has_nonstandard_port.description: 1 if an explicit port other than 80/443 is present.

has_userinfo.label: Embedded username
has_userinfo.description: 1 if the URL contains a 'user[:pass]@' component.

has_punycode.label: Punycode hostname
has_punycode.description: 1 if any hostname label is IDNA/punycode encoded ('xn--').

letter_count.label: Letters
letter_count.description: ASCII letters in the whole URL.

digit_count.label: Digits
digit_count.description: ASCII digits in the whole URL.

letter_ratio.label: Letter share
letter_ratio.description: ASCII letters divided by URL length.

slash_count.label: Slashes
slash_count.description: '/' characters in the whole URL (scheme '//' included).

url_entropy.label: URL character entropy
url_entropy.description: Shannon entropy (bits per character) of the whole URL.

hostname_entropy.label: Hostname character entropy
hostname_entropy.description: Shannon entropy (bits per character) of the hostname.

suspicious_token_count.label: Suspicious keywords
suspicious_token_count.description: Distinct entries from the documented keyword list found in the URL.

has_suspicious_token.label: Any suspicious keyword
has_suspicious_token.description: 1 if at least one keyword from the list is present.

score_definition: phishing_score = P(class 0) as estimated by the model; not a calibrated real-world probability
trained_on: domain-grouped training partition (the same model that was evaluated; the test partition was never used for fitting or tuning)

preprocessing.scheme_policy: inputs without a scheme are analysed as http://<input>
preprocessing.dedup_policy: exact duplicate URLs and same-label near duplicates (case-insensitive, trailing slash) removed; conflicting labels dropped (none found)

dataset.name: PhiUSIIL Phishing URL Dataset
dataset.citation: Prasad, A. & Chandra, S. (2024). PhiUSIIL: A diverse security profile empowered phishing URL detection framework based on similarity index and incremental learning. Computers & Security, 136, 103545. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cose.2023.103545
